sentences.en: About the beginning of the 19th century the chief silk-producing regions of the world were the Levant (including Broussa, Syria and Persia), India, Italy and France, the two first named sending the low-priced silk, the other two the fine qualities.

sentences.en: If you plan to purchase an expensive item, or a group of low-priced items, you can budget your funds accordingly.
